summaryTitle: Germantown in 1688: new settlers and a community apart
excerpt: Leaving Wynona for a moment, we’re now back in 1688 Germantown. The Krefeld pioneers who arrived in 1683 have been joined by numerous others. As we mentioned last time, Richard Townsend has set up a mill and Cornelius Bom opened his bakery.
